featured_reviews.review_text:
I just wanted to share my wonderful experience with Dr. Krupa Sankhe and hopefully help other patients who may be struggling with allergies like I was.

For months, I was dealing with constant sneezing, nasal congestion, itchy eyes, and disturbed sleep. I kept guessing the reasons — weather changes, pollution, food — but nothing seemed certain. It was frustrating not knowing the exact trigger.

When I consulted Dr. Krupa Sankhe, she patiently listened to my history and suggested a skin prick test to accurately identify the cause. I was a little nervous at first, but she explained the entire procedure so calmly that I felt completely comfortable.

The skin prick test was quick and almost painless. Within a short time, the results clearly showed that the exact cause of my allergy was dust mites allergy. I finally had a clear answer! After months of uncertainty, it was such a relief to know precisely what was triggering my symptoms.

Dr. Sankhe immediately started me on a nasal spray and appropriate anti-allergy medication. She also guided me on practical steps to reduce dust mite exposure at home. Within days, I noticed a significant improvement. My sneezing reduced dramatically, my nose felt clearer, and I started sleeping peacefully again. Now, I feel lighter, more energetic, and much more in control of my health.

What truly stood out to me was her compassionate approach. She didn’t just treat my symptoms — she helped me understand my condition. That clarity itself reduced half my stress.

If you are suffering from unexplained allergies, I strongly encourage you not to ignore it. Getting a proper diagnosis through a simple test can completely change your quality of life. I am genuinely grateful for the care I received and so happy with the results.

Thank you, Dr. Krupa Sankhe, for helping me breathe freely again!

Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) disorders refer to conditions affecting the jaw joint and surrounding muscles that control jaw movement. These issues can lead to discomfort and difficulty in everyday functions such as chewing, speaking, and opening or closing the mouth comfortably. 

Common symptoms of TMJ problems include jaw pain, clicking or popping sounds while moving the jaw, facial discomfort, headaches, ear-related discomfort, and stiffness in the jaw area. These symptoms may develop gradually and can be influenced by factors such as stress, teeth grinding, jaw injury, or bite misalignment. 

An evaluation by an ENT specialist can help identify the underlying cause and rule out other related conditions. Diagnosis typically involves a detailed clinical assessment and, when needed, imaging studies to understand joint function and structure. 

Management of TMJ disorders focuses on reducing discomfort and improving jaw function. This may include lifestyle modifications, jaw exercises, stress management techniques, and other conservative treatment approaches based on individual needs.
